name: guide-lazy-load
description: Issue #177: joining a world must not rebuild the guide (the recipe sync only marks it stale); the first book open pays the rebuild. Read the run's latest.log: the first '[lib.guide] Loaded ...' line is logged after the book is used and not at the join, and carries the per-phase timing split; a second one follows the datapack reload done with the book open (the open book rebuilds at once, the other timing to compare). The pages must still draw, including the Stirling Engine's crafting recipe panel; a second open of the book rebuilds nothing.
